subject: Archaeology
title: Spears, Traps, and Hunting Strategies
description: A quick win: understand Spears, Traps, and Hunting Strategies.

hook.text: Wooden spears from 400,000 years ago were found in a German coal mine — they were sharpened, balanced, and deadly.

buildup.text: The Schöningen spears were found alongside butchered horse bones. Hunters ambushed herds at a lakeside.

discovery.text: The spears are as long as modern javelins and weighted for throwing. These were designed weapons, not sharpened sticks.

twist.text: This was 200,000 years before Homo sapiens appeared. Homo heidelbergensis made them — an ancestor, not modern humans.

climax.text: Group hunting requires coordination, planning, and communication. Weapon design implies language existed very early.

punchline.text: They designed balanced throwing weapons 400,000 years ago.

quiz.question: What is remarkable about the Schöningen spears?
options: They are the oldest metal weapons ever found
They were balanced for throwing, 200,000 years before Homo sapiens existed
They were made from a stone material not found in Germany
